headline: Lions and Vikings byes take out St. Brown, Jefferson and Hockenson, so add a WR and start Lloyd, Golden and McLaurin.
alerts: Week 6 byes: Lions and Vikings (St. Brown, Jefferson, Hockenson). Start McLaurin and Golden at WR with Downs at FLEX.
Sleeper could not be reached this run. Roster and free agent status are based on last week's list, so confirm in the app's Waivers tab.
Breece Hall (quad) is week to week. Check Wednesday and Thursday practice reports before slotting him over Mitchell.
Sun 10:00 AM: Robinson, Downs, Hurts and Jets D lock. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Lloyd, Golden, Ferguson.
Sun 6:30 AM: Texans at Jaguars in London. None of your players are in it.
Mon 5:15 PM: McLaurin at San Francisco. Keep a late-game backup in mind in case his hamstring flares up.
Week 6 player props are not posted yet. A later run will add prop numbers.

ARI.note: At Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -12.5, total 52.5. Arizona about 20 implied points.

PHI.note: Vs. Carolina Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Eagles -1.5, total 43.5. Barkley, Smith and Shipley injuries.

ATL.note: Vs. Chicago Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Falcons -1.5, total 47.5.

LAC.note: At Kansas City Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Chiefs -8.5, total 43.5. Chargers about 17.5 implied points.

GB.note: Vs. Dallas Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. Packers -1.5, total 52.5.

DAL.note: At Green Bay Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. CeeDee Lamb has a quad injury.

WAS.note: At San Francisco Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. 49ers -7.5, total 50.5.

IND.note: Vs. Tennessee Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -7, total 44.5.

NYJ.note: At New England Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Patriots -7.5, total 44.5.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Week 5: 29 of 47 for 292 yards, 3 TD, 1 INT in a 45-21 loss to Detroit.
He is averaging about 45 attempts a game, and Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog at the Rams, so volume should stay high.
Arizona implied for about 20 points. Kickoff Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific.
Marvin Harrison Jr. was traded, and rookie Carson Beck could take over later in the season. Not a Week 6 worry yet.

sources.title: CBS: Lions at Cardinals box score

6904.name: Jalen Hurts
notes: Week 5 in London: 21 of 40 for 220 yards and 1 TD, with only 2 rushing yards.
Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith both missed Week 5, and Will Shipley hurt his foot, so the offense is thin.
Eagles are 1.5-point home favorites over Carolina with a 43.5 total, about 22.5 implied points. Kickoff 10:00 AM Pacific.

11581.name: MarShawn Lloyd
notes: Week 5: 10 carries, 31 yards and 2 TDs on 27 snaps, his first career scores.
Josh Jacobs is still on the commissioner exempt list, Chris Brooks is on IR, and Kaleb Johnson's role has shrunk.
Packers host Dallas Sunday night, 5:20 PM Pacific. Green Bay is a 1.5-point favorite with a 52.5 total, about 27 implied points.

8154.name: Brian Robinson
notes: He is the clear backup to Bijan Robinson, who had 17 carries and 4 catches in the Week 5 overtime loss.
Before Week 5 he had 35 carries and 4 TDs over three games, but his last outing before that was 7 carries for 16 yards.
Falcons host Chicago at 10:00 AM Pacific, 1.5-point favorites with a 47.5 total, about 24.5 implied points.

9511.name: Keaton Mitchell
notes: Week 5: 6 carries for 11 yards and 3 catches for 18 yards in a loss to Denver.
Kimani Vidal's snap share has risen each week, so this looks like a committee.
Chargers are 8.5-point underdogs at Kansas City, only about 17.5 implied points. Kickoff 1:25 PM Pacific.

8155.name: Breece Hall
notes: Quad injury, missed the last two games and is week to week.
Braelon Allen ran 24 times for 116 yards and the game-winning TD in Week 5, so Hall may share work when he returns.
Jets are 7.5-point underdogs at New England, about 18.5 implied points. Kickoff 10:00 AM Pacific. Watch Wednesday and Thursday practice.

7547.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
notes: Lions are on bye in Week 6.
Week 5: 6 catches on 11 targets for 69 yards.

sources.title: CBS: Lions at Cardinals box score

6794.name: Justin Jefferson
notes: Vikings are on bye in Week 6.

5844.name: T.J. Hockenson
notes: Vikings are on bye in Week 6.
He is also dealing with a concussion. Top drop candidate this week.

5927.name: Terry McLaurin
notes: Played through his hamstring in Week 5 and caught all 4 targets for 62 yards.
Stefon Diggs (hamstring) missed Week 5, which leaves more targets for McLaurin.
Commanders are 7.5-point underdogs at San Francisco on Monday night, 5:15 PM Pacific. Trailing script helps passing volume.

12501.name: Matthew Golden
notes: Week 5: 6 catches for 123 yards, including catches of 36 and 50 yards.
Packers host Dallas Sunday night, 5:20 PM Pacific, in the highest total game on the slate at 52.5.

9500.name: Josh Downs
notes: Week 5: 3 catches on 6 targets for 47 yards in a loss at Pittsburgh.
Colts are 7-point home favorites over Tennessee, about 25.75 implied points. Kickoff 10:00 AM Pacific.

sources.title: NBC: Downs held to three catches

8110.name: Jake Ferguson
notes: Your only healthy TE with Hockenson on bye.
CeeDee Lamb is nursing a quad injury, which could push a few more targets to Ferguson.
Cowboys at Packers Sunday night, 5:20 PM Pacific, 52.5 total, Dallas about 25.5 implied points.

NYJ.name: New York Jets
notes: Jets had 8 sacks and allowed 12 points to Cleveland in Week 5.
Week 6 is at New England, a 7.5-point favorite with about 26 implied points.
The Colts D/ST at home vs. Tennessee is a better stream if available.

comparisons.why: Brissett's pass volume as a big underdog beats Hurts in a low-total game with his top weapons hurt.

sources.title: CBS: Lions at Cardinals box score

comparisons.why: If you only need one of them, Robinson gets a better game script at home. Mitchell is in a committee and the Chargers project for only 17.5 points.
Hall is week to week with a quad injury. Switch to Hall only if he gets a full practice by Friday.

waivers.name: Germie Bernard
waivers.why: Steelers rookie ran a route on 94% of dropbacks with 9 targets, 6 catches and 80 yards. Pittman is on IR and Roman Wilson is out. Drop Hockenson.

waivers.name: Kendrick Bourne
waivers.why: Cardinals WR2 after the Harrison trade, 8 targets in Week 5, and he shares your Brissett stack. Drop Jets D or Mitchell.

sources.title: CBS: Lions at Cardinals box score

waivers.name: Dameon Pierce
waivers.why: Played 48 snaps with Barkley out and Shipley hurt. Could lead the Eagles backfield in Week 6. Drop Mitchell if needed.

waivers.name: Dontayvion Wicks
waivers.why: Had 8 targets for 63 yards with DeVonta Smith out. A bye-week flex if Smith misses again.

waivers.name: Indianapolis Colts
waivers.why: Home vs. Tennessee as a 7-point favorite, about 4% rostered in Yahoo. Drop the Jets D, who play at New England.
